body.name: Uniform acquisition certificate \(E\)
body.construction: \(E\) is a lexicographically ordered finite list of uniform records. After empty ownership masks are discarded, the nonempty factor masks \(J\) partition \([k]\). Each decoded \(S\) lies in \(\Pi\); \(\mathcal O_{\mathrm{src}}(S)\) returns a law handle and support table; each decoded \(\ell\) names a positive well-typed slice; and \(b_T\) names one extracted source factor. For every owned \(C_j\), the same selected protocol, slice, source, and transcript schema succeeds for every branch in \(\Omega_j\), so source choice is outside the assignment-and-equality-type quantifier. Records sharing a protocol pay its cost once. The exact certificate length is \(N_E=\sum_{R\in E}\bigl(|\mathcal A|+|\mathrm{LIT}|+k+|V|(1+|\mathrm{LIT}|)+\sum_{j\in J(R)}|\operatorname{enc}(\tau_j)|\bigr)\).
